synthesizedFacts.fact: Vitamin C is a potent antioxidant that helps protect the skin from UV damage and free radicals, reduces wrinkles, fades discoloration, and boosts collagen production.
L-ascorbic acid is the most effective and widely studied form of vitamin C, but it is also the least stable.
Vitamin C can be used in both morning and night skincare routines, but it should be applied to clean skin before moisturizer and SPF in the morning.
Vitamin C should not be mixed with exfoliating acids and retinoids as it may cause discomfort.
